verse: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
hook: When doing the right thing feels pointless
reflection: Good work rarely pays off on your timeline. This verse promises a harvest, but it comes in due season, and it comes to the people who keep going.
apply: Keep one good habit going, even unseen
Help someone who can't pay you back
closing: What are you tempted to give up on?
caption: The harvest comes in due season. Keep going.
